entities.name: José Antonio Labordeta
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Antonio Labordeta Subías was a Spanish Aragonese singer, songwriter, poet, writer and political activist. He was described by The Gran Enciclopedia Aragonesa as "The most important Aragonese singer-songwriter". He began singing in an attempt to give more relevance to his poetry; his songs are well-known and beloved anthems in Aragón. Poetic songs such as "Aragón", "Canto a la libertad" or "Me dicen que no quieres" also gained national popularity.
